dedupe_keys.name: systeme d information sur l eau drinking water datasets

description: Système d'Information sur l'Eau: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Système d'Information sur l'Eau. Coverage: Système d'Information sur l'Eau. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aires d'Alimentation de Captages - France entière; Aires d'Alimentation de Captage - Mayotte; Services publics d'eau potable - jeux de données exploités pour les ra. Formats seen: 0-HTTP--LINK, WMS, OGC:WMS, PAGE WEB, 7Z. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
